+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
+
+
+def conditional_update(table_name: str, document_id: str, new_content: str, expected_version: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb", region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION"))
+    table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
+    try:
+        response = table.update_item(
+            Key={"document_id": document_id},
+            UpdateExpression="SET content = :content, version = version + :inc",
+            ConditionExpression="version = :expected_version",
+            ExpressionAttributeValues={
+                ":content": new_content,
+                ":inc": 1,
+                ":expected_version": expected_version,
+            },
+            ReturnValues="ALL_NEW",
+        )
+        return {"ok": True, "item": response.get("Attributes", {})}
+    except ClientError as exc:
+        if exc.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code") == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
+            return {"ok": False, "error": "version_mismatch"}
+        raise
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    table_name = os.environ["DYNAMODB_TABLE_NAME"]
+    document_id = os.environ["DOCUMENT_ID"]
+    new_content = os.environ["NEW_CONTENT"]
+    expected_version = int(os.environ["EXPECTED_VERSION"])
+    result = conditional_update(table_name, document_id, new_content, expected_version)
+    print(json.dumps(result))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from pinecone import Pinecone
+
+
+def _get_env(name: str, required: bool = True, default: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    value = os.getenv(name, default)
+    if required and not value:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Missing required environment variable: {name}")
+    return value or ""
+
+
+def _coerce_value(value: str) -> Any:
+    lowered = value.lower()
+    if lowered == "true":
+        return True
+    if lowered == "false":
+        return False
+    if lowered == "null":
+        return None
+    try:
+        if "." in value:
+            return float(value)
+        return int(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return value
+
+
+def _build_filter(field: str, raw_value: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {field: {"$eq": _coerce_value(raw_value)}}
+
+
+def query_documents(field: str, value: str, namespace: Optional[str] = None, top_k: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = _get_env("PINECONE_API_KEY")
+    index_name = _get_env("PINECONE_INDEX_NAME")
+    pc = Pinecone(api_key=api_key)
+    index = pc.Index(index_name)
+    query_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "vector": [0.0],
+        "top_k": top_k,
+        "filter": _build_filter(field, value),
+        "include_metadata": True,
+    }
+    if namespace:
+        query_kwargs["namespace"] = namespace
+    response = index.query(**query_kwargs)
+    matches = getattr(response, "matches", None) or response.get("matches", [])
+    return [
+        {
+            "id": match.get("id") if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "id", None),
+            "score": match.get("score") if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "score", None),
+            "metadata": match.get("metadata") if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "metadata", None),
+        }
+        for match in matches
+    ]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: query_documents.py <field> <value> [namespace] [top_k]")
+    field = sys.argv[1]
+    value = sys.argv[2]
+    namespace = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] else None
+    top_k = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 10
+    results = query_documents(field, value, namespace=namespace, top_k=top_k)
+    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+COGNITO_HOST = os.environ.get("COGNITO_HOST", "")
+COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID", "")
+COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
+
+
+def _normalize_document(document: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(document, str):
+        return json.loads(document)
+    if isinstance(document, dict):
+        return document
+    raise TypeError("document must be a dict or JSON string")
+
+
+def _get_primary_id(document: Dict[str, Any], primary_key: str) -> Any:
+    if primary_key not in document:
+        raise KeyError(f"missing primary identifier: {primary_key}")
+    value = document[primary_key]
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        raise ValueError("primary identifier cannot be empty")
+    return value
+
+
+def upsert_document(document: Any, primary_key: str = "id", endpoint: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    payload = _normalize_document(document)
+    doc_id = _get_primary_id(payload, primary_key)
+    base_url = endpoint or COGNITO_HOST
+    if not base_url:
+        raise ValueError("missing endpoint or COGNITO_HOST")
+    url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/documents/{doc_id}"
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID and COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET:
+        headers["X-Cognito-App-Client-Id"] = COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID
+        headers["X-Cognito-App-Client-Secret"] = COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET
+    response = requests.put(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    if response.content:
+        try:
+            return response.json()
+        except ValueError:
+            return {"status_code": response.status_code, "text": response.text}
+    return {"status_code": response.status_code}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: upsert_document.py '<json>' [primary_key]")
+    document = sys.argv[1]
+    primary_key = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "id"
+    result = upsert_document(document, primary_key=primary_key)
+    print(json.dumps(result))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+COGNITO_HOST = os.environ.get("COGNITO_HOST", "")
+COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID", "")
+COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
+
+
+def _normalize_document(document: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(document, str):
+        return json.loads(document)
+    if isinstance(document, dict):
+        return document
+    raise TypeError("document must be a dict or JSON string")
+
+
+def _get_primary_id(document: Dict[str, Any], primary_key: str) -> Any:
+    if primary_key not in document:
+        raise KeyError(f"missing primary identifier: {primary_key}")
+    value = document[primary_key]
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        raise ValueError("primary identifier cannot be empty")
+    return value
+
+
+def upsert_document(document: Any, primary_key: str = "id", endpoint: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    payload = _normalize_document(document)
+    doc_id = _get_primary_id(payload, primary_key)
+    base_url = endpoint or COGNITO_HOST
+    if not base_url:
+        raise ValueError("missing endpoint or COGNITO_HOST")
+    url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/documents/{doc_id}"
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID and COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET:
+        headers["X-Cognito-App-Client-Id"] = COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID
+        headers["X-Cognito-App-Client-Secret"] = COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_SECRET
+    response = requests.put(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    if response.content:
+        try:
+            return response.json()
+        except ValueError:
+            return {"status_code": response.status_code, "text": response.text}
+    return {"status_code": response.status_code}
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: upsert_document.py '<json>' [primary_key]")
+    document = sys.argv[1]
+    primary_key = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "id"
+    result = upsert_document(document, primary_key=primary_key)
+    print(json.dumps(result))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
